# libfgsb3c interface from C

This is the fork of the libfgsb3 from cran with the following
differences: - The return type has changed is is very similar to what
`optim` returns - Allows a direct C/C++ interface through a R registered
function, similar to C interface to `optim` with 2 additional
arguments. - Allows adjustment of tolerances for minimization success. -
Added `xtolAtol` and `xtolRtol` minimization success criterion. - Added
`maxit` termination

# Package index

## All functions

- [`.lbfgsb3cPtr()`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/lbfgsb3c/reference/dot-lbfgsb3cPtr.md)
  : Get the lbfgsb3c pointer
- [`lbfgsb3c()`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/lbfgsb3c/reference/lbfgsb3c.md)
  [`lbfgsb3()`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/lbfgsb3c/reference/lbfgsb3c.md)
  [`lbfgsb3f()`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/lbfgsb3c/reference/lbfgsb3c.md)
  [`lbfgsb3x()`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/lbfgsb3c/reference/lbfgsb3c.md)
  : Interfacing wrapper for the Nocedal - Morales LBFGSB3 (Fortran)
  limited memory BFGS solver.
